notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
openssl s_client against port 993 (IMAPS) provides interactive raw IMAP session over TLS after initial handshake. Used for manual mail enumeration: folder listing, message selection, reading mail content.

=== IMAP COMMANDS ===
1 LOGIN user pass → authenticate
1 LIST "" * → list all folders
1 SELECT INBOX → select folder
1 FETCH 1 (BODY[]) → read first message
1 LOGOUT → close session

=== CERTIFICATE ===
openssl exposes full cert chain: CN (hostname), O (organization), email → cross-reference with DNS SOA admin email, SNMP contact.
